_note: Message classes only, on the member-choice ladder (dane ruling 2026-09-02 under the standing owner rule): every class ships LOCKED. Owner/prospect-facing classes stay locked until the member opts in on the cover sheet (external send autonomy: yes); once opted in, a class graduates by its accuracy window one category at a time, lowest consequence first, and the BD manager can re-lock any class at any time. Internal classes graduate by the same window without the opt-in. A correction on a released message demotes its class immediately and triggers stop-and-wait. THE NEVER-GRADUATES SET IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT FROM THIS FILE: fee or package deviation, any management-agreement language or threshold change, anything on the Never-Promise List, any legal or fair housing answer, any property acceptance of a red-flag property, and the decision to decline an owner or walk away.
_cite: Class vocabulary is a seat default, not a questionnaire answer -- no BDM question asks for a message-class taxonomy. Recorded in the assembly report NO-SOURCE table.

board_row_write.description: Writing or updating a row on the pipeline board: stage move, next action, touch log, notes.

alert_triage_note.description: Recording which alert fired, what was done, and the new next-action date.

internal_status_to_manager.description: Pipeline status, alert digest, and review packs sent to the BD manager.

meeting_confirmation.description: Confirming a discovery call or listing appointment already agreed on a live call: time, place, who attends.

appointment_reminder.description: The pre-appointment reminder touch on an appointment already on the calendar.

post_call_recap.description: The recap of a call that already happened, restating only what the owner said and what was agreed.

nurture_value_touch.description: A value touch to a nurture-stage lead drawn from the approved message library: no offer, no fee, no promise.

cold_outreach_first_touch.description: The first outbound touch to a prospect who has not engaged.

intake_form_link_send.description: Sending the owner intake form link after an agreement is fully executed.
